# Commands

<!-- Generated by `dragongl_server --print-commands` from the table of
     src/server/cmd_help.c. Do not edit: change the table, then run
     `tools/quality.sh commands-fix`. -->

Commands are typed in the window of the client (Enter opens the command
line) or in its terminal. A leading `/` is accepted: `/look` is `look`.
A command typed without what it needs answers with its usage. Movement
and the camera have keys, not commands: F1 in the client lists them.

In the game, `help` lists the topics below, `help <topic>` the commands
of one, `help <command>` explains a command.

`<n>` is the number an item has in the list the command works on (the
backpack, the goods of a merchant, the things on the ground); where
`item` is allowed, part of its name works too.

## Exploring

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `look` | `l` | What you see around you, by direction, and what lies under your feet. |
| `examine` | `ex` | The terrain one step away in every direction: what a wall is made of and what mining it could yield. |
| `search` | `s` | Look for hidden traps and secret passages nearby. |
| `open <n\|s\|e\|w>` | `o` | Open the door in that direction. |
| `close <n\|s\|e\|w>` | `c` | Close a door you opened. |
| `tunnel <n\|s\|e\|w\|d>` | `T`, `t` | Mine the wall in that direction, or dig down (d), with a pickaxe or a shovel. |
| `disarm [salvage] [magic]` | `D` | Disarm an adjacent trap: with your hands, or with 'magic' by dispelling it; 'salvage' also recovers its parts, at a harder roll. A bad roll springs the trap. |
| `get [n\|ne\|e\|se\|s\|sw\|w\|nw] [n]` | `g` | Pick up what lies on your tile, or on the adjacent one in that direction; with several things there, the one numbered n. |
| `pickup` |  | Take back what your tombstone holds, standing on it. |
| `retrieve` |  | Recover your soul and equipment from your ghost, next to it. |
| `fountain` |  | Drink from the sacred fountain of the town (floor 0) to heal your wounds. |
| `statue` | `crystal` | Meditate at a crystal statue of the town: no fatigue, no hunger, spell slots restored. |
| `rest` | `R` | In town (floor 0): recover all hit points and spell slots. |
| `pray` | `p` | Sacrifice 100 XP to the gods to recover a quarter of your hit points. |

## Character

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `status` | `stats` | Your character sheet: abilities and modifiers, armour class, conditions. |
| `train <str\|dex\|con\|int\|wis\|cha\|random>` |  | Spend a point earned at a level-up on an ability (the full name works too). |
| `save` |  | Save your character now. |
| `top` | `leaderboard` | The ranking of the players. |
| `event` |  | The global event in progress, if any. |
| `help [topic\|command\|all]` | `?` | The topics; the commands of a topic; what one command does; every command. |

## Items and equipment

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `inventory` | `i` | Your backpack, belt and equipment. |
| `wear <n\|item>` | `equip`, `wield`, `w` | Put on or wield an item of the backpack. |
| `remove <slot\|item>` | `unequip`, `takeoff` | Take off an equipped or belted item. |
| `belt <n>` |  | Move an item from the backpack to the belt, where it is at hand. |
| `unbelt [n\|item]` |  | Move an item from the belt back to the backpack. |
| `use <n\|item>` | `quaff`, `q`, `read`, `r`, `eat`, `e`, `zap`, `z` | Use an item: drink a potion, read a scroll, eat, zap a wand. |
| `drop <n>` | `d` | Drop an item of the backpack on the ground. |
| `throw <n\|item> [n\|s\|e\|w]` | `v` | Throw an item: 5 tiles, 8 for ammunition. It lands where its flight ends. |
| `fill <lantern>` |  | Refill a lantern with a flask of oil. |
| `lore <n\|item>` |  | What is known about an identified item of the backpack; for a book, its spells. |

## Magic and class rituals

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `spells` |  | The spells you know. |
| `cast <spell> [target]` | `c` | Cast a spell you know; the book that holds it must be with you. |
| `study <n\|book>` | `awaken`, `invoke`, `intone`, `celebrate`, `pronounce`, `practice`, `drill`, `rage`, `sneak`, `meditate` | Learn the spells of a book, inside the temple of your class in town, with the word of your class: study (Wizard), pray &lt;n> (Cleric), awaken (Druid), invoke (Warlock), intone (Bard), celebrate (Paladin), pronounce (Sorcerer), practice (Ranger), drill (Fighter), rage (Barbarian), sneak (Rogue), meditate (Monk). |

## Merchants and services

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `talk` |  | Greet the merchant next to you. |
| `list` |  | The goods of the merchant next to you. |
| `browse <n>` |  | The description of an item for sale. |
| `buy <n\|item>` |  | Buy an item from the merchant. |
| `sell <n\|item>` |  | Sell an item of the backpack. |
| `haggle buy\|sell <n\|item>` |  | Bargain on one deal (Charisma): the next buy or sell of that item has the new price, better or worse. |
| `identify [n]` |  | Have the first unidentified item identified, or the one numbered n (100 gold). |
| `repair [slot\|item]` |  | Have a worn piece of equipment repaired by the blacksmith of the town. |
| `cure` |  | Have diseases and poisons cured (50 gold). |
| `uncurse` |  | Have a curse removed (200 gold). |

## Trade between players

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `trade <player>` |  | Propose a trade to a player next to you. |
| `offer <gold> [n]` |  | Put gold, and item n of the backpack, on the table. |
| `accept` |  | Accept the trade as it stands. |
| `cancel` |  | Call the trade off. |

## Party and chat

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `say <text>` | `shout` | Speak to the players near you on this floor. |
| `msg <player> <text>` | `tell`, `whisper` | A private message to a player online. |
| `who` |  | The players online and their floors. |
| `block <player>` |  | Stop receiving the messages of a player. |
| `unblock <player>` |  | Receive them again. |
| `blocks` | `blocklist` | The players you have blocked. |
| `invite <player>` |  | Invite a player to your party. |
| `join` |  | Accept the last invitation. |
| `leave` |  | Leave your party. |
| `party` |  | The members of your party. |

## Dungeon Master

Only for the `dm` account (see the server manual for its password).

| Command | Also | What it does |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `dm_goto <floor> <x> <y>` |  | Teleport. |
| `dm_spawn <bestiary_id> <x> <y>` |  | Create a monster on your floor. |
| `dm_spawn_boss <floor>` |  | Create the boss of a floor again. |
| `dm_boss <floor>` |  | The bosses of a boss floor (10, 20, ...): where they are, their statistics and loot. |
| `dm_merchant <floor>` |  | The wandering merchant of a floor (5, 15, 25, ...). |
| `dm_find_monster <name>` |  | Bestiary entries whose name contains the text. |
| `dm_find_item <name>` |  | Items whose name contains the text. |
| `dm_shop <item_id> [quantity]` |  | Add an item to the goods of the merchant within 5 steps. |
| `dm_place <item_id> <x> <y>` |  | Place a treasure chest that holds the item. |
| `dm_gold <amount>` |  | Add gold to your purse, or remove it. |
| `dm_level <level>` |  | Raise your level (20 at most). |
| `dm_pdf <floor>` |  | Write the colour map of a floor as a PDF. |
| `dm_mapfloor` |  | The same, for the floor you are on. |
| `dm_telemetry` |  | Round and event-loop times, queues, clients and NPCs. |
